name: Saeki Yuzuru
source:
Saeki works out of a police box in Shinjuku, and attended the police academy with the protagonist. The two of them often go drinking, usually at Saeki's behest, and much to the protagonist's display, she often ends up having to care for him once he's been overserved.

[From the [url=http://www.aksysgames.com/malice/characters/]official English website[/url]]
